ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Solve for x: x + 3 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 10

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 72

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

14. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 56

17. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 81

18. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 40

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 28
   C. 14
   D. 22

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 18
   C. 30
   D. 36

26. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

27. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

28. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

29. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

30. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81
